beni.translation: n. 安良城红（日本歌手名）；贝尼省（玻利维亚的一个省）；贝尼酒吧（上海市的一家酒吧名）

benight.definition:
v overtake with darkness or night
v envelop with social, intellectual, or moral darkness
v make darker and difficult to perceive by sight

benighted.definition:
s. overtaken by night or darkness
s. lacking enlightenment or knowledge or culture
benighted.translation: a. 赶路到天黑的, 陷入黑暗的, 愚昧的

benighting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Benight
benighting.translation:
使陷入黑暗
使愚昧无知
使视线模糊

benightment.definition: n. The condition of being benighted.

benign.definition:
a. not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive (especially of a tumor)
a. pleasant and beneficial in nature or influence
s. kindness of disposition or manner
benign.translation:
a. 善良的, 良性的
[医] 良性的

benign glycosuria.translation: [医] 良性糖尿, 肾性糖尿

benign metastasizing goiter.translation: [医] 良性转移性甲状腺肿

benign neprosclerosis.translation: [医] 良性肾硬化, 良性肾硬变[病]

benign prostatic hyperplasia.translation: [医]良性前列腺增生：与年龄相关的腺体和基质增生所致前列腺肥大，一般始于5旬，可使尿道受压而致梗阻

benignity.definition: n. the quality of being kind and gentle
